questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. Making a right turn here is illegal and unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs tell you that something is prohibited. This sign means you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangular sign with black lettering means no passing zone. You will see it at the start of an area where you cannot pass other vehicles on a two-lane road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign marks a railroad crossing. It appears a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign shows traffic moving right around an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided into separate directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic light image warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to respond to the traffic light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts drivers to roadwork ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic controls in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is ahead. Slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears on vehicles that travel at slow speeds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the rear of a vehicle means it travels at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, horse-drawn wagons, and carriages. During the day it appears as a solid orange triangle. At night it appears as a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic signals are at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for traffic on the other road to pass before you proceed. You do not need to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but you should always slow down and enter with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead and are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that traffic may merge into their lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of special conditions or hazards ahead. They are typically yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red arrow pointing left means you must stop completely before the intersection or crosswalk. Stay stopped while the red arrow is displayed.
